integrity: The proof is analytic. Finite exhaustive and constructive checks are supporting verification only and are not used as substitutes for infinite arguments.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to finite complete bipartite graphs. Originality was compared against the initiating paper, the 2026 minimum-degree-three-colour theorem and its K_{3,4} obstruction, targeted web searches, published-finding corpus searches, and the published published-finding corpus threshold record. The indexed published-finding corpus summary rather than a separately fetched full public text was available for that record, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed corollary.
title: Strong majority index of complete bipartite graphs
